inspiration: Boss entry with a boss class flag and a separate MVP prize table with per-item rates (db/re/mob_db.yml lines 1840-1844). Idea: a boss is one flag away from a different reward ceremony.
Boss skill range longer than its chase range (db/re/mob_db.yml lines 1827-1828). Idea: ranged skills fire before the boss closes in, so the threat is felt early.
A numbered catalogue of hit and impact effects that scripts can trigger (doc/effect_list.md line 3). Idea: a small named list of hit feels, each paired with a sound cue.
A flat monster skill script table keyed by monster (db/re/mob_skill_db.txt lines 1-4). Idea: each monster is a list of skills with cast conditions in one text table.
Attack delay and motion fields on each boss entry (db/re/mob_db.yml around line 1834). Idea: wind-up and recovery are data fields, so each telegraph is tunable.
